target.commit must be a 40-hex commit hash
target.fetch_hint must be the runnable durable PR-ref
scene.parameters must publish the non-empty parameter object
configuration.resolved must be a non-empty object
configuration.fallback_policy must be a non-empty string
metrics.physical must record a non-empty measurement 'method'
metrics.numerical is unsupported but has no non-empty reason
evidence.commands must be a non-empty list of commands
evidence must carry raw_rows inline or non-empty raw_paths
evidence.visual must list visual artifacts or be typed
result.claim_boundary must be a non-empty string
result.limitations must be a non-empty list
